context: D+3 device follow-up after the Soundbox swap; before Diwali and before fee go-live.
source: scripted text transcript (audio deferred; Hindi in Roman script)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Namaste Ravi ji. Ye visit service quality ke liye record ho rahi hai, theek hai?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Soundbox ka kya haal hai? Technician parso aaya tha na?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Haan, naya device laga diya. Ab sab theek chal raha hai, har payment announce ho raha hai.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Accha. Diwali ka rush kaisa chal raha hai?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Rush toh hai, lekin festive stock ke liye paisa kam pad raha hai. Kya mujhe stock ke liye loan mil sakta hai? Do-teen lakh chahiye tha.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Loan partner lender dete hain, eligibility wahi decide karte hain. Main aapki request RM ko bhej deta hoon, wo poori details aur charges batayenge.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Theek hai. Aur agar beech mein paisa aa jaye toh jaldi chuka sakte hain? Prepayment pe koi penalty toh nahi lagegi?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ye lender ki terms pe depend karta hai. RM aapko KFS mein sab likhit mein dikhayenge.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ek baat aur. Doosri company wale aaye the, bol rahe the unka charge kam hai, aur machine bhi free denge. Socha aapko bata doon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Samajh gaya, ye main note kar raha hoon. Aapke actual charges ka hisaab bhi main bhijwa deta hoon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Abhi bahut busy hoon bhai. Diwali ke baad aana, aaram se baat karenge.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Bilkul, Diwali ke baad aata hoon. Happy Diwali, Ravi ji.
